status: Absolute movement and captured-source fixes passed local checks. Control-taking cards are not yet enabled.

rules.interpretation: An opposing base is not a valid unit destination under 107.1.c. Current 449.2.c replaces that attempted relocation with Recall. The older Origins FAQ instead described a Move to the controller's base; current Core wording is used.

implementation: Shared movement module separates actor, physical unit and absolute destination. Move event snapshots retain the actor and both BoardLocations.

Pending Ezreal activation finds its live physical source, while your base remains the original ability controller's base. A control change can therefore replace the attempted Move with Recall, preserving readiness and damage.

Tideturner can finish selecting targets and resolving after its source changes control. Its target still must belong to the ability controller; both original physical locations survive the two relocations.
A player-specific restriction prevents that actor's Move rather than forcing a Recall. Ready is independent of a prevented Move or unchanged location.
API contexts add actor/origin_location/destination_location while preserving nullable origin/destination lane fields. Faefolk AI and Arcane Shift consume the updated facts.
No-op moves leave battlefield control untouched; the existing Back Alley regression caught and verified the correction.

validation.format: cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check passed
validation.scope: Four new engine tests cover both players and sixteen Tideturner combinations, alongside existing engine/API/client and ten integration suites. No new native rendering campaign or assembled control-card acceptance is claimed.

regression_evidence.result: Both original Ezreal and Tideturner scenarios failed against the old runtime because the borrowed physical source remained at its battlefield.
Compile errors identified remaining Arcane Shift and Faefolk consumers of the former MoveFacts shape; both updated.
All four new movement scenarios passed.
1188 library tests passed; existing Back Alley no-op regression failed. Corrected control refresh to run only after a real location change.

remaining: Implement Possession and Conscription through real play actions, including target finalization, optional XP payment, ordered resolution and AI/UI/companion behavior.
Use those card scenarios to audit/fix remaining captured source, Hidden/Empower/payment/return continuations and live API references.
Complete game campaigns and immutable installed acceptance before publication.
